en_US.title: Deep Reach Site Accountability Copy
en_US.scanner: Deep Reach copy: not cartoon villains; culpable weighting under real physics.
en_US.field_note: Use the public lie as contrast: real tide, real failure, missing weighting layer, missing delayed rescue chain.
en_US.terminal: PUBLIC DOSSIER LOCK: say culpable weighting; do not say omnipotent conspiracy.
en_US.audio: They did not order the water to rise. They made the exit wait.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Deep Reach Site Accountability Copy keeps the public article honest without flattening the cause.
en_US.external_site: Deep Reach's crime was not magic control over the ocean. It was the conversion of risk, rescue and human names into delay-tolerant corporate procedure.
